method: Independent model second-author review of all 61 root decisions, all proposed lexical senses/templates and all 114 exact whole-word applications against the current retained English source. Supplemental Spanish legal, institutional, hair and sporting definitions were examined for argument roles. This confirms only unchanged selected word-level readings and source-bound templates, not automatic agreement, dictionary-provided English, examples, native-human certification or new measured coverage. Explicit inanimate accusative it/them only; no animate person is renamed it, no suffix/accent inference, unknown dative/reflexive, multiple clitic, negative, indicative or new paradigm is authorized. Root holds are scoped to this absent/unproven template and may be revisited only with a separately bound proposal. Obsolete, vulgar, figurative, colloquial and regional restrictions remain part of their selected senses.

approvedTemplates.context: Selected legal homograph: annul a judicial ruling or proceeding; not marry someone. Supplemental Spanish legal definition supports the inanimate judgment.
approvedTemplates.notes: Exact legal annulment/cassation sense with Spanish judgment/proceeding evidence; not an animate marriage patient or physically overturning an object.

approvedTemplates.context: Selected ball-catching sense, especially a goalkeeper; not hunting an animate animal.
approvedTemplates.notes: Catching an inanimate ball is independently supplied by the selected English sense; Spanish supplemental acquisition is broader and does not itself establish football.

approvedTemplates.context: Selected institution/foundation endowment; not a human dowry or innate gifts. Supplemental Spanish source explicitly includes funding an institution.
approvedTemplates.notes: The institution/foundation receives an endowment; it is a legitimate nonpersonal entity. No human dowry recipient or innate gift is substituted.

approvedTemplates.context: Completely selected obsolete destroy sense of a distinct source homograph; not the contemporary sexual sense. Keep obsolete label and warn that modern FOLLAR is vulgar sexual usage.
approvedTemplates.notes: Retain obsolete destruction context and explicit warning that contemporary FOLLAR is vulgar sexual usage. The exact obsolete English-source homograph table independently supplies bare folla as its informal singular imperative; the separately supplied whole FÓLLALA/FÓLLALO records are not generated by suffix inference. Do not reuse the different bellows homograph fuella paradigm.
